title: DAY 23/90
MACHINE DESIGN
scenes.sub: Parts rarely break at one big load. They tire out.
scenes.voice: Day twenty three of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, eighty five days left! Most machine parts fail from fatigue, not one big load. Let's design against both.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: We start Machine Design today. Topic: static and fatigue design, a sure source of GATE M. E. numericals.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover the theories of failure, stress concentration and notch sensitivity, the endurance limit with the S N curve, and the Goodman and Soderberg lines.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Soderberg draws the line to yield strength, Goodman to ultimate strength. So Soderberg is the most conservative, and Gerber's parabola the least.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Get the free practice PDF on Telegram now. Test runs seven to nine P. M. Take it through our Telegram channel link, or visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 22 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day twenty two toppers! Ayush Naik takes rank one with a perfect thirty, Rahul Yadav rank two, and Kunal rank three. Congratulations to all three!
